title: Design System: Ledgendary marketing home (v2)
scope: site-v2/ only (v2 alternate). Not a project-wide system; site/ (v1) and site-v3/ are competing alternates in their own worlds. Derived from site-v2/styles.css, site-v2/index.html, site-v2/app.js as finished 2026-11-18 after the finish review and fix round. Review screenshots predate the final stylesheet; the CSS wins.

display.purpose: Hero headline, two lines, second in headline-tint. 640px: clamp(2.5rem, 11.6vw, 3.25rem).

figure.purpose: The pinned $42,000 (blue, tabular); dial readout at clamp(2.5rem, 4vw, 3.5rem).

doc-title.purpose: Portal, screen and invoice titles; option prices at the same size, tabular.

lede.purpose: Hero, section and closing ledes, 34 to 58ch.

label.purpose: Table headers and field labels; sentence case.

role-tag.purpose: Client / Studio / Books tags in the hero step track and time sidebar group heads only; uppercase, never above a heading.

icons.size: 1em of context (17 to 18px in rails and glyph tiles)

shadows.name: shadow-field
shadows.purpose: Hero card on the blue field.

shadows.name: shadow-field-sm
shadows.purpose: Journal entries on the books field.

shadows.name: shadow-paper
shadows.purpose: Windows and the dial on white; windows add 0 0 0 1px rgba(20, 28, 120, 0.08).

shadows.name: current-item
shadows.purpose: Active rail icon and segmented option.

shadows.name: inset-field-panel
shadows.purpose: Blue-deep panels on the field (tamper console, closing waitlist).

shadows.name: armed-ring
shadows.purpose: A button the play is waiting on (send, ready signature).

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global focus on white and inside white surfaces; on blue grounds the outline is #c8ff3d.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Springy responses: pop, chip swap, stamp, step dot, switch knob.

motion.name: t-slow
motion.purpose: View wipes, screen slides, stamp, dock.

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: Anything that newly appears as a result of a click.

motion.name: stamp
motion.value: scale 1 to 1.07 to 1, 500ms, with lime fill

motion.name: dock
motion.purpose: The books row docking in ink when posted.

motion.name: wait-dots
motion.value: three 5px blue dots, 1.1s, three cycles, staggered 0.18s

motion.name: slide
motion.purpose: Story screens entering from one side and leaving by the other.

motion.name: idle
motion.purpose: Hero deal continues on its own after 8s without input, only while on screen.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 1ms, single iteration; hero opens on the finished deal; story screens static
motion.purpose: Content and state never depend on motion.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Hero stacks with the track beside the copy; chain two per row; time sidebar stacks.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Nav links hidden; section grids single column; story becomes stacked screens under a sticky ink figure pill.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Form stacks; hero track and rail hidden; option cards compact; chain vertical; timesheet per-person grids.

breakpoints.name: short-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Tightens the hero so the whole deal card fits the first screen.

narrative.overview:
A saturated ultramarine field that the visitor plays on. The blue owns three chapters edge to edge (hero with nav, the books, the closing call); white sections sit between them. On the field, white type and crisp white product surfaces; on white, near-black ink. One accent, acid lime, behaves like a stamp of done-ness: the primary button, the chosen option, Paid, a posted hash, the active step. It is always a fill carrying ink, never a line or a text colour, with one exception: the keyboard focus outline on blue grounds.

Every claim is a working product surface (client portal, studio invoice, timesheet, journal chain, organisation settings) built from one anatomy: a 14 to 16px white window, a quiet `panel` bar with workspace mark, breadcrumb and a "Demo data" tag, hairline-divided rows, and Lucide line icons at stroke 2. The visitor's click is the trigger: picking an option, signing, sending, adding time, flipping a tamper switch, dragging a team-size dial. The page answers with short, springy UI responses (200 to 500ms, exponential ease-out); an 8 second idle lets the hero deal finish on its own, and reduced motion opens on the finished state.

Type is one superfamily: Funnel Display set heavy (750 to 800) and tight (-0.025 to -0.04em) for statements, titles and money; Funnel Sans for everything read and every control. Money is tabular wherever it appears.
keyCharacteristics: Drenched: ultramarine is the ground of three chapters, not an accent; white sections alternate with it.
One accent, acid lime, as fill with ink text; the lime focus outline on blue is the single line use.
Product surfaces are white on every ground, with soft navy shadows on the field and lighter blue-tinted shadows on white.
Funnel Display heavy and tight for display and figures; Funnel Sans for reading and UI.
Interaction-led motion: the visitor triggers state; motion confirms it, and everything has a static reduced-motion state.

rules.name: The Field Owns Three Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine drenches exactly the hero (with nav), the books chapter and the closing call. Story, time, scale and playbook are white, separated by 1px `line` hairlines. A fourth blue chapter is a change to the world, not a section choice.

rules.name: The Lime Is a Stamp Rule
rules.body: Lime is a fill with ink text on it, on any ground. Never lime text, lime borders or lime lines, and never white on lime. The single exception is the keyboard focus outline (and the waitlist input's focus halo) on blue grounds, where lime reads at about 6:1.

rules.name: The Semantics Stay Inside Rule
rules.body: Green, red, pink and amber appear only inside product surfaces, the tamper console and form validation. Headings, ledes and page chrome use blue, white, ink and lime alone.

rules.name: The Heavy and Tight Rule
rules.body: Display, titles, prices and totals are Funnel Display at 750 to 800 with negative tracking (-0.02 to -0.04em). Reading text and controls are Funnel Sans at 400 to 650 with no tracking.

rules.name: The Money Is Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every money figure carries `tabular-nums`: prices, totals, journal amounts, time cells, the pinned figure and the dial readout.

rules.name: The Windows Float, Sections Don't Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to product surfaces, the prompt chip and the lime button. Section grounds, headings and copy never cast one, and panels on the field are inset, not raised.

dos: Do keep ultramarine to the hero, the books chapter and the closing call, with white sections between.
Do use lime as a fill with ink text: the primary button, the chosen thing, Paid, posted, the current step.
Do switch the focus ring to lime on blue grounds and keep it blue on white and inside white surfaces.
Do set display, titles, prices and totals in Funnel Display 750 to 800 with negative tracking; keep reading text in Funnel Sans.
Do set every money figure in tabular numerals.
Do put every product claim in a white window with the "Demo data" tag and the same job's figures (Northwind Co, option B, $42,000).
Do let the visitor's click drive state, answer within 200 to 500ms on the shared easing, and give every interactive beat a finished static state under reduced motion.
donts: Don't set lime text, lime borders or lime lines (focus on blue excepted), or white text on lime.
Don't use green, red, pink or amber outside product surfaces, the tamper console and validation.
Don't add a fourth blue chapter or tint white sections blue.
Don't put shadows on section grounds or headings, or use hard offset shadows; panels on the field are inset.
Don't add uppercase tracked labels or eyebrows above headings; uppercase is limited to the step track's role tags and the time sidebar's group heads.
Don't use a wink in a primary button label.
